question: After the combined graph correction, does V5 improve the preregistered seven exploration metrics over original M-TARE and recover the failures observed in defective V9 across ten randomized blocks?
method: Read only the exact sealed composed 90-case summaries and exact sealed corrected V5 30-case summaries, enforce identity pairing, and run the unchanged randomized-block statistics.
baseline: Original M-TARE is the primary performance baseline. Defective V9 is the causal correction baseline; layered GT-map is diagnostic and is not treated as an upper bound.

user_authorization.scope: One immutable Gate-6 read-only corrected comparison after both exact source seals bind.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope.

acceptance_criteria: The source audit is exact sealed PASS with 90 cases, ten blocks, family quotas 30/30/30, source quotas 69+21 and the frozen schedule file/content hashes.
The corrected V5 run is exact sealed PASS with 30 unique M1D cases, ten blocks of three and checkpoint quotas 10/10/10.
Corrected and defective V9 identities match exactly for every case and every block has three checkpoint pairs.
Qualitative panels use exactly garage_env11 and tunnel_env11, original repeat0 and checkpoint0, selected only by identity; every trajectory and topology snapshot is verified against its source seal.
All seven metric comparisons are finite and use exact sign-flip, 10,000-sample block bootstrap and Holm correction over ten independent blocks.
The corrected-run mechanism summary is verified against its source seal and three result/mechanism table sets are generated as CSV, Markdown and LaTeX with no manual value entry.

All 90 source and 30 corrected coverage curves are verified against their originating seals and aggregated on the fixed 0--600 second grid as ten block means with descriptive pointwise bootstrap intervals.
Source mutation, raw-bag read, training, optimizer, parameter/checkpoint selection and C09/C10 reads are zero.
stop_conditions: Any source seal, manifest, schedule, case identity, family/source/checkpoint quota or frozen tool drift.
Any incomplete block, non-finite metric, changed statistic or outcome-driven selection.
Any source mutation, raw bag/GT/map access, training or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: Seal-bound composed-source and corrected-V5 manifests with exact schedule hashes.
Seven-metric V5-vs-M-TARE and V5-vs-defective-V9 analyses with block differences, confidence intervals, exact tests and Holm decisions.
Three statistical and two fixed trajectory/topology figures, each as PNG and vector PDF, with source hashes and zero outcome-based selection.
One four-method coverage-time figure as PNG/PDF plus case-level and ten-block aggregate CSV/JSON, with all 120 curve hashes recorded.
Three deterministic paper table sets covering family summaries, paired effects and V5 mechanism counts, each as CSV, Markdown and LaTeX with source-seal provenance.
Primary result summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
